companyDescription: Autonomous defense & drone platform · Sentrycs C-UAS integrated into Lockheed Martin's Sanctum C2 · Record Q1 revenue ($50.1M, +1,079% YoY), $390M FY26 guide · Near-term insider-selling/resale overhang weighing on price despite strengthening fundamentals
priceNote: Down from $8.27 (Jul 1) as insider/holder selling escalated — not a fundamentals problem. Record Q1, raised guidance, and new orders all landed over the same window.
summary: Ondas has transformed from a small SDR company into a multi-domain autonomous defense platform via 6 acquisitions in 2026. Q1 revenue was $50.1M (+1,079% YoY), FY2026 is guided to at least $390M, and Sentrycs' counter-drone tech is now integrated into Lockheed Martin's Sanctum C2 platform. 6 analysts rate it Strong Buy with a $20.14 average target (+154%). The near-term overhang is real, though: CEO Eric Brock sold $31.9M in shares, a new prospectus registered 3.378M existing shares for resale (from the Omnisys/World View deals), and a Form 144 flags more potential insider selling — pure supply pressure, not a change in the business.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Q2 orders already exceeded $110M (vs Q1's $50.1M). The $390M FY guide requires a back-half revenue ramp — this report shows whether backlog is actually converting. Watch gross margin trend (~49% in Q1).

catalysts.name: Insider / Resale Share Overhang — Watch for Clearing
catalysts.description: CEO sold 2,378,245 shares (~$31.9M); a new prospectus registered 3,378,084 existing shares for resale (Jun 26, from the Omnisys/World View acquisitions — no fresh cash to the company); a Form 144 flags additional shares potentially for sale. This is the actual driver of the recent decline, not a business problem.

catalysts.name: Cyberhawk Acquisition Close
catalysts.description: $125M acquisition of Cyberhawk — AI-enabled drone inspection for critical infrastructure (power lines, pipelines, telecom towers). Closes Q3 2026. Opens a non-defense revenue stream.

catalysts.name: $4.3B DoD/NATO Pipeline
catalysts.description: 45+ global program submissions; Sentrycs is now part of Lockheed's standard counter-drone architecture (Sanctum, announced Jun 23). LADOS C2 debuted at Eurosatory 2026 — a potential NATO contract anchor.

risks: Insider-selling and resale-share overhang has escalated, not cleared — CEO's $31.9M sale, a 3.378M-share resale registration, and a Form 144 for more all point the same direction: more supply willing to sell at these prices
Severe share dilution — shares outstanding grew sharply over the past year from ATM issuance and acquisition stock payments; the resale registrations add tradable float without adding cash
Negative operating cash flow — burned $38.7M in FY2025; Q1 2026 improved but still pre-positive FCF, and sentiment has recently focused on widening quarterly losses/cash burn
Acquisition integration risk — 6 acquisitions in 2026 (Sentrycs, Mistral, World View, Omnisys, Cyberhawk) creates real cultural and systems complexity
Revenue concentration — the $390M guide depends on a handful of large defense contracts; program delays would mean a guidance miss
Defense budget risk — reconciliation/procurement timeline shifts at DoD could slow order conversion

estimateDates.note: Tests whether $110M+ in Q2 orders converts to recognized revenue at the guided pace
Opens non-defense (critical infrastructure inspection) revenue stream

analystTargets.note: Range $16-25; unchanged even as the stock sold off on insider selling, not a fundamentals downgrade

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds held at 3.50-3.75% since a string of meetings; FedWatch prices an ~89% probability of another hold at the Jul 28-29 FOMC. As a pre-profit, financing-dependent small-cap, Ondas is more rate-sensitive than a self-funding business — a higher-for-longer path raises the cost of any future capital raise.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Next CPI print (June data) is Jul 14, 2026, ahead of the FOMC meeting. A hot print would reinforce the Fed's already-hawkish lean and pressure high-beta growth names like ONDS further.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: MEDIUM. Defense/homeland-security program spending itself is policy-driven and largely rate-insensitive, but ONDS's own equity financing and trading multiple are exposed to the broader hawkish-Fed backdrop (10yr yield ~4.48%) more than the underlying government-contract business is.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk MEDIUM — the Jul 29 FOMC decision itself is well-telegraphed as a hold, so it's not a near-term surprise risk. The bigger macro sensitivity is ONDS's rate-exposed, pre-profit balance sheet, not the FOMC meeting date itself.

entryStrategy.verdict: Buy the overhang, not the story breaking — Q1 revenue +1,079% YoY and the $390M FY guide are transformative, and the Lockheed/Sentrycs validation is real. The insider/resale selling is a supply problem, not a demand problem. Size small (3-5%) given real dilution and cash-burn risk.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Ondas has historically run hard into and after strong quarterly prints — the stock ran from roughly $7 to $13.36 in June 2026 on Q1 beat and backlog-growth momentum, before the current insider-selling pullback interrupted it.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 2-4 สัปดาห์ก่อน earnings, ตาม order-flow newsflow

postWin.note: AeroVironment (AVAV), a comparable defense-drone name, jumped 19% on a strong earnings beat tied to the broader defense-spending surge (Jun 30, 2026). Ondas's own June 2026 run (~$7 to $13.36) on its Q1 beat and backlog growth is the more direct historical comp for this exact stock.

postLose.note: A guidance cut or evidence that the $4.3B pipeline isn't converting would remove the core bull thesis and likely trigger a sharp re-rate, on top of the existing dilution overhang.
postLose.exampleDate: Typical pattern for guidance-dependent small-cap defense names

spotSizing.reason: 4% — moderate speculative sizing. Fundamentals and analyst conviction are both strong, but real, ongoing share-supply overhang (insider sales, resale registrations, Form 144) and pre-profit cash burn keep this in speculative-sizing territory, not core-holding territory.
